name: QuillBot
tagline: Rewrite, summarise and check text with a set of AI writing tools.
shortDescription: AI writing toolkit known for paraphrasing, with summarising, grammar checking and other writing utilities.
description: QuillBot is an online writing toolkit best known for its paraphrasing tool, which rewrites sentences and paragraphs in different ways while aiming to keep the original meaning.
Alongside paraphrasing it offers tools such as a summariser and grammar checker. Students and content writers commonly use it to rework their own drafts or condense long material.
Paraphrasing tools should be used responsibly: rewording someone else's work does not make it original, and academic institutions have their own rules about AI-assisted writing.

keyFeatures.title: Grammar checking
keyFeatures.description: Checks text for grammar, spelling and punctuation mistakes.

keyFeatures.title: Browser access
keyFeatures.description: Use the web app, or check the official site for browser extensions and integrations.

howItWorks: Open the QuillBot website and choose a tool, such as the paraphraser.
Paste or type your text into the input box.
Pick a mode and run the tool.
Compare the output with your original and edit it — always check that meaning and facts are preserved.
useCases: Rewording your own drafts for clarity
Varying sentence structure in content writing
bestFor: Students reworking their own notes and drafts
Writers who want alternative phrasings quickly
notIdealFor: Anyone hoping to disguise copied work — this is plagiarism

checklist: Meaning preservation across the paraphrasing modes on a fixed test passage
Summary accuracy on a long article with known key points
Free plan word/character limits on the date of testing
Grammar checker accuracy compared with a dedicated grammar tool

faqs.a: QuillBot offers a free plan with limits, and paid plans with more features. Check the official website for current limits.

faqs.q: Is using a paraphrasing tool plagiarism?
faqs.a: Paraphrasing someone else's work without credit can still be plagiarism. Use paraphrasing tools on your own writing, cite sources, and follow your institution's or employer's rules.
